purpose: Extensible lexicon of political ideologies, doctrines, systems and movements with definitions and normalized compass coordinates.
method: Coordinates are analytical approximations, not claims that an ideology is reducible to two dimensions. Each entry can later receive multidimensional scores and evidence.
entries: No-ruler political philosophy seeking voluntary, non-hierarchical social organization.

Anarchism organized around worker unions and direct worker control.

Political family prioritizing individual liberty and limiting coercive government.

Preference for inherited institutions, continuity, gradual reform and social stability.

note: This is a living taxonomy. Labels overlap, change over time, and can be used descriptively without endorsing them. Historical variants and country-specific meanings should receive separate entries rather than being collapsed into one universal definition.
